run_genarris_jobs: run Genarris crystal structure generation jobs for molecules from a CSV file using SLURM
create_genarris_jobs: create and submit Genarris structure generation jobs for a molecule with different Z values
create_gnrs_config: create a Genarris ui.conf configuration file for a specific molecule and space group
create_gnrs_submit_script: create a SLURM submission script for executing Genarris crystal structure generation
get_genarris_config: extract and validate the Genarris configuration section from the main workflow config
